supersededNote: Retained as the historical baseline. Prefer the canonical snapshot for any argument about the format: this one's firmware version is unknown and its manifest provenance is indirect.
firmwareVersionNote: Not recorded at capture time, and now unrecoverable -- the device has since been updated twice. This omission is the defect that motivated ADR-0006's corpus-refresh requirement: a corpus whose firmware is unknown cannot support any argument about drift. Recorded as an explicit null rather than an absent field so the gap is visible.

integrity.aggregateScope: sha256 of the concatenated per-file sha256 digests of stock/*.template plus templates.json, filenames sorted; truncated to 32 hex chars

contents.stock/: The 65 templates reMarkable shipped at capture time. All declare "author": "reMarkable".
contents.templates.json: The stock manifest, with no user entries merged in.

userTemplatesNote: The owner's three custom templates were originally filed under this snapshot in a user/ directory. That was a category error -- they are not firmware artefacts and would have had to be duplicated into every future snapshot -- so they now live in research/reference_material/user_templates/.

verifications.trigger: firmware update applied; it wiped the owner's custom templates and he re-applied them
verifications.firmwareVersionNote: Not captured. This is the release immediately preceding 3.29.1.0 -- a second update was already downloaded and awaiting reboot at the time -- so the running firmware was the earlier one. Exact version unknown.
verifications.method: manual scp; the owner's custom templates were then removed and the saved-aside stock templates.json restored, to recover a pristine stock state for comparison. Provenance is therefore indirect, which is why this was not promoted to its own snapshot.

verificationSummary: The stock corpus is byte-identical across three firmware generations: this March 2026 baseline, the release preceding 3.29.1.0 (verification 1 above), and 3.29.1.0 itself (its own snapshot). Both updates wiped the owner's custom templates while leaving all 65 stock templates untouched -- the product's core use case (PRD 4.6), now observed twice rather than assumed.
